questions.qAf: Die oppervlakte onder ’n snelheid-tyd-grafiek stel die … voor.

questions.q: An object is dropped from rest and falls freely for 1 s. The distance it falls is …
questions.qAf: ’n Voorwerp word uit rus laat val en val vir 1 s vry. Die afstand wat dit val, is …

questions.q: Mechanical energy is the sum of …
questions.qAf: Meganiese energie is die som van …
options: kinetic energy and gravitational potential energy.

questions.q: In a transverse wave, the distance between two successive crests is the …
questions.qAf: In ’n transversale golf is die afstand tussen twee opeenvolgende kruine die …

questions.q: Which type of electromagnetic radiation has the lowest frequency?
questions.qAf: Watter soort elektromagnetiese straling het die laagste frekwensie?

sections.intro: Choose the correct answer. Use g = 9,8 m·s⁻², c = 3 × 10⁸ m·s⁻¹, h = 6,63 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s and e = 1,6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C where needed.
sections.introAf: Kies die korrekte antwoord. Gebruik g = 9,8 m·s⁻², c = 3 × 10⁸ m·s⁻¹, h = 6,63 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s en e = 1,6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C waar nodig.

questions.q: Define a scalar quantity.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n skalaarhoeveelheid.
points: A physical quantity that has magnitude

questions.scenario: A runner jogs 50 m north, then 80 m south and then 20 m north. The whole run takes 75 s.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Hardloper draf 50 m noord, dan 80 m suid en dan 20 m noord. Die hele draf duur 75 s.

questions.q: Calculate the total distance covered.
questions.qAf: Bereken die totale afstand wat afgelê is.

questions.q: Determine the resultant displacement of the runner.
questions.qAf: Bepaal die resulterende verplasing van die hardloper.

questions.q: Calculate the average speed and the average velocity of the runner.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gemiddelde spoed en die gemiddelde snelheid van die hardloper.

questions.q: Explain why the distance is greater than the magnitude of the displacement.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die afstand groter is as die grootte van die verplasing.
points: The runner changed direction, so part of the path cancels out in the displacement
pointsAf: Die hardloper het van rigting verander, dus kanselleer ’n deel van die roete in die verplasing

questions.q: Forces of 12 N west, 20 N east and 5 N west act on an object. Determine the resultant force.
questions.qAf: Kragte van 12 N wes, 20 N oos en 5 N wes werk op ’n voorwerp in. Bepaal die resulterende krag.

sections.title: Motion in one dimension: graphs

questions.q: Describe the motion of the car between t = 8 s and t = 20 s.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die beweging van die motor tussen t = 8 s en t = 20 s.

questions.q: Calculate the acceleration of the car during the first 8 s.
questions.qAf: Bereken die versnelling van die motor gedurende die eerste 8 s.

questions.q: Calculate the acceleration of the car between t = 20 s and t = 26 s.
questions.qAf: Bereken die versnelling van die motor tussen t = 20 s en t = 26 s.

questions.q: Calculate the total displacement of the car in the 26 s.
questions.qAf: Bereken die totale verplasing van die motor in die 26 s.
points: Displacement = area under the graph: ½(8)(12) = 48 m
total = 228 m in the direction of motion
pointsAf: Verplasing = oppervlakte onder die grafiek: ½(8)(12) = 48 m

questions.q: Calculate the average velocity of the car for the whole 26 s.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gemiddelde snelheid van die motor vir die hele 26 s.
points: = 8,77 m·s⁻¹ in the direction of motion

questions.q: Sketch the acceleration–time graph for the motion of the car from t = 0 s to t = 26 s.
questions.qAf: Skets die versnelling-tyd-grafiek vir die beweging van die motor van t = 0 s tot t = 26 s.

questions.q: Describe the shape of the position–time graph between t = 8 s and t = 20 s, and explain your answer.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die vorm van die posisie-tyd-grafiek tussen t = 8 s en t = 20 s, en verduidelik jou antwoord.
points: A straight line sloping upwards (constant positive gradient)
the gradient of a position–time graph is the velocity
and the velocity is constant during this time
pointsAf: ’n Reguit lyn wat opwaarts skuins loop (konstante positiewe gradiënt)
die gradiënt van ’n posisie-tyd-grafiek is die snelheid
en die snelheid is gedurende hierdie tyd konstant

sections.intro: The velocity–time graph below shows the motion of a car along a straight road.
sections.introAf: Die snelheid-tyd-grafiek hieronder toon die beweging van ’n motor langs ’n reguit pad.

questions.scenario: A taxi travelling at 30 m·s⁻¹ brakes uniformly and comes to rest in 6 s.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Taxi wat teen 30 m·s⁻¹ ry, rem eenvormig en kom in 6 s tot stilstand.

questions.q: Calculate the acceleration of the taxi.
questions.qAf: Bereken die versnelling van die taxi.

questions.q: Calculate the braking distance.
questions.qAf: Bereken die remafstand.

questions.q: The driver’s reaction time is 0,7 s. Calculate the total stopping distance of the taxi.
questions.qAf: Die bestuurder se reaksietyd is 0,7 s. Bereken die totale stopafstand van die taxi.

questions.scenario: A ball is dropped from rest from the top of a building and hits the ground 3 s later. Ignore air resistance.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Bal word uit rus van die bopunt van ’n gebou laat val en tref die grond 3 s later. Ignoreer lugweerstand.

questions.q: Calculate the speed of the ball just before it hits the ground.
questions.qAf: Bereken die spoed van die bal net voordat dit die grond tref.

questions.q: Calculate the height of the building.
questions.qAf: Bereken die hoogte van die gebou.

questions.q: Define free fall.
questions.qAf: Definieer vryval.
points: Motion in which the only force acting on the object is gravity
pointsAf: Beweging waarin die enigste krag wat op die voorwerp inwerk, gravitasie is

questions.q: Define kinetic energy.
questions.qAf: Definieer kinetiese energie.

questions.q: State the principle of conservation of mechanical energy.
questions.qAf: Stel die beginsel van behoud van meganiese energie.
points: The total mechanical energy in an isolated system
pointsAf: Die totale meganiese energie in ’n geïsoleerde sisteem

questions.scenario: A 3 kg ball is released from rest at A, 6 m above the ground, and rolls down a frictionless track. B is 2,5 m above the ground and C is on the ground.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Bal van 3 kg word uit rus by A, 6 m bo die grond, losgelaat en rol teen ’n wrywinglose baan af. B is 2,5 m bo die grond en C is op die grond.

questions.q: Calculate the gravitational potential energy of the ball at A.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gravitasie-potensiële energie van die bal by A.

questions.q: Write down the mechanical energy of the ball at A.
questions.qAf: Skryf die meganiese energie van die bal by A neer.
points: 176,4 J (the kinetic energy at A is zero)
pointsAf: 176,4 J (die kinetiese energie by A is nul)

questions.q: Calculate the speed of the ball at B.
questions.qAf: Bereken die spoed van die bal by B.

questions.q: Calculate the speed of the ball at C.
questions.qAf: Bereken die spoed van die bal by C.

questions.q: On a rough track of the same shape, the ball reaches C at 9 m·s⁻¹. Calculate the mechanical energy converted to other forms of energy.
questions.qAf: Op ’n growwe baan met dieselfde vorm bereik die bal C teen 9 m·s⁻¹. Bereken die meganiese energie wat na ander vorme van energie omgeskakel is.

questions.q: The speed of a car triples. By what factor does its kinetic energy change? Explain.
questions.qAf: Die spoed van ’n motor verdriedubbel. Met watter faktor verander sy kinetiese energie? Verduidelik.
points: It becomes nine times as large
because E_k = ½mv², so E_k ∝ v²
pointsAf: Dit word nege keer so groot
omdat E_k = ½mv², dus E_k ∝ v²

sections.title: Transverse waves

questions.q: Define the amplitude of a wave.
questions.qAf: Definieer die amplitude van ’n golf.
points: The maximum displacement of a particle

questions.q: Write down the amplitude of the wave.
questions.qAf: Skryf die amplitude van die golf neer.

questions.q: Determine the wavelength of the wave.
questions.qAf: Bepaal die golflengte van die golf.

questions.q: Calculate the period of the wave.
questions.qAf: Bereken die periode van die golf.

questions.q: Calculate the speed of the wave.
questions.qAf: Bereken die spoed van die golf.

questions.q: Name TWO points on the diagram that are in phase.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE punte op die diagram wat in fase is.
points: P and R (or Q and S)
pointsAf: P en R (of Q en S)

questions.q: The frequency is halved while the wave travels on the same spring. What happens to the wavelength? Explain.
questions.qAf: Die frekwensie word gehalveer terwyl die golf op dieselfde veer beweeg. Wat gebeur met die golflengte? Verduidelik.
points: The speed stays the same in the same medium
v = fλ, so λ is inversely proportional to f
pointsAf: Die spoed bly dieselfde in dieselfde medium
v = fλ, dus is λ omgekeerd eweredig aan f

sections.intro: The diagram shows a transverse wave on a spring. The wave has a frequency of 4 Hz.
sections.introAf: Die diagram toon ’n transversale golf op ’n veer. Die golf het ’n frekwensie van 4 Hz.

questions.q: Explain why sound is called a longitudinal wave.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom klank ’n longitudinale golf genoem word.
points: The particles of the medium vibrate
parallel to the direction in which the wave travels
pointsAf: Die deeltjies van die medium vibreer
ewewydig aan die rigting waarin die golf beweeg

questions.q: A ship sends a sound pulse to the sea floor and receives the echo 2 s later. The speed of sound in sea water is 1 500 m·s⁻¹. Calculate the depth of the sea.
questions.qAf: ’n Skip stuur ’n klankpuls na die seebodem en ontvang die eggo 2 s later. Die spoed van klank in seewater is 1 500 m·s⁻¹. Bereken die diepte van die see.
points: the sound travels down and back, so divide by 2
pointsAf: die klank beweeg af en terug, dus deel deur 2

questions.q: What is the range of frequencies that humans can hear?
questions.qAf: Wat is die reeks frekwensies wat mense kan hoor?

questions.q: Give ONE use of ultrasound other than in medicine.
questions.qAf: Gee EEN gebruik van ultraklank buiten in medisyne.
points: Sonar to find the depth of the sea or shoals of fish, or cleaning delicate objects
pointsAf: Sonar om die diepte van die see of visskole te bepaal, of die skoonmaak van delikate voorwerpe

questions.q: Which property of a sound wave determines its pitch?
questions.qAf: Watter eienskap van ’n klankgolf bepaal sy toonhoogte?

questions.q: Explain why sound travels faster in water than in air.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom klank vinniger in water as in lug beweeg.
points: The particles in water are closer together than in air
so the vibrations are passed on more quickly
pointsAf: Die deeltjies in water is nader aan mekaar as in lug
dus word die vibrasies vinniger oorgedra

questions.q: Arrange the following in order of INCREASING wavelength: infrared, gamma rays, ultraviolet, radio waves.
questions.qAf: Rangskik die volgende in volgorde van TOENEMENDE golflengte: infrarooi, gammastrale, ultraviolet, radiogolwe.

questions.q: Calculate the frequency of orange light with a wavelength of 600 nm.
questions.qAf: Bereken die frekwensie van oranje lig met ’n golflengte van 600 nm.

questions.q: Calculate the energy of one photon of this light.
questions.qAf: Bereken die energie van een foton van hierdie lig.

questions.q: X-rays are more dangerous to living tissue than radio waves. Explain why.
questions.qAf: X-strale is gevaarliker vir lewende weefsel as radiogolwe. Verduidelik waarom.
points: X-rays have a much higher frequency
so each photon carries much more energy (E = hf)
pointsAf: dus dra elke foton baie meer energie (E = hf)

questions.q: State the principle of charge quantisation.
questions.qAf: Stel die beginsel van ladingskwantisering.
points: Every charge is a whole-number multiple
of the charge of one electron, e
pointsAf: van die lading van een elektron, e

questions.scenario: Two identical metal spheres on insulated stands carry charges of +10 nC (sphere A) and −4 nC (sphere B). They are brought into contact and then separated.
questions.scenarioAf: Twee identiese metaalsfere op geïsoleerde staanders dra ladings van +10 nC (sfeer A) en −4 nC (sfeer B). Hulle word in kontak gebring en dan geskei.

questions.q: Calculate the charge on each sphere after they are separated.
questions.qAf: Bereken die lading op elke sfeer nadat hulle geskei is.

questions.q: Calculate the number of electrons transferred, and state the direction in which they moved.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal elektrone wat oorgedra is, en noem die rigting waarin hulle beweeg het.
points: Change in charge of B = 3 − (−4) = 7 nC
pointsAf: Verandering in lading van B = 3 − (−4) = 7 nC

questions.q: Explain why a charged balloon can stick to a neutral wall.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n gelaaide ballon teen ’n neutrale muur kan vassit.
points: The balloon causes the charges in the wall to separate (polarisation), with opposite charge closest to the balloon
the attraction of the nearby opposite charge is stronger than the repulsion of the like charge further away
pointsAf: Die ballon laat die ladings in die muur skei (polarisasie), met teenoorgestelde lading die naaste aan die ballon
die aantrekking van die nabye teenoorgestelde lading is sterker as die afstoting van die gelyke lading verder weg

questions.q: Explain why an object cannot have a charge of 4 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n voorwerp nie ’n lading van 4 × 10⁻¹⁹ C kan hê nie.
points: charge is quantised: it must be a whole-number multiple of e
pointsAf: lading is gekwantiseer: dit moet ’n heelgetal-veelvoud van e wees

sections.title: Electric circuits

questions.q: Define potential difference.
questions.qAf: Definieer potensiaalverskil.
points: The work done per unit charge
to move charge between two points (V = W/Q)
pointsAf: om lading tussen twee punte te beweeg (V = W/Q)

questions.q: Calculate the equivalent resistance of R₂ and R₃.
questions.qAf: Bereken die ekwivalente weerstand van R₂ en R₃.

questions.q: Calculate the total resistance of the circuit.
questions.qAf: Bereken die totale weerstand van die stroombaan.

questions.q: Calculate the reading on the ammeter.
questions.qAf: Bereken die lesing op die ammeter.

questions.q: Calculate the reading on the voltmeter.
questions.qAf: Bereken die lesing op die voltmeter.

questions.q: Calculate the current through R₃.
questions.qAf: Bereken die stroom deur R₃.
points: V across the parallel part = 9 − 4,5 = 4,5 V
pointsAf: V oor die parallelle deel = 9 − 4,5 = 4,5 V

questions.q: Calculate the charge that passes through the battery in 3 minutes.
questions.qAf: Bereken die lading wat in 3 minute deur die battery vloei.

sections.intro: In the circuit below the battery has an emf of 9 V and negligible internal resistance. R₁ = 3 Ω is in series with R₂ = 4 Ω and R₃ = 12 Ω, which are in parallel. The ammeter and the connecting wires have negligible resistance, and the voltmeter has a very high resistance.
sections.introAf: In die stroombaan hieronder het die battery ’n emk van 9 V en weglaatbare interne weerstand. R₁ = 3 Ω is in serie met R₂ = 4 Ω en R₃ = 12 Ω, wat in parallel is. Die ammeter en die verbindingsdrade het weglaatbare weerstand, en die voltmeter het ’n baie hoë weerstand.
